eld.notes: ESL endorsement (Primary-Grade 12) is an add-on to a base KY teaching certificate. 16 KAR 2:200 requires admission to an EPSB-approved preparation program; goteachky.com requires passage of appropriate assessments for each endorsement. Practicum is set per program and not enumerated in regulation, so coded null.

history.title: Baseline coding (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Initial coding of the SEA's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI credentials, professional teaching standards, and EL-population data. Captured Oct–Dec 2019 for the EPAA 29(100) document analysis; this row is the as-of-2019 snapshot against which subsequent verifications are diffed.

history.title: Kentucky adopts State Seal of Biliteracy
history.description: Kentucky's State Seal of Biliteracy was authorized in 2021 and is administered by KDE for high-school graduates proficient in English plus one or more world languages. Adoption postdates the Leider 2019 baseline and so was not captured there.

history.title: Re-audit (history events captured)

No coding changes; this pass added Seal of Biliteracy adoption to the history log per the §3a history-capture emphasis.
